column1: # Shared scrubber fixture: ONE list of cases that the Python scrubber (core/audit.py scrub_url_credentials, used by core/logscrub.py), the
# PowerShell copy in scripts/collect-diagnostics.ps1 and the awk copy in scripts/collect-diagnostics.sh must all satisfy.
# Columns, separated by ONE TAB: name, known values (joined by "|", or "-" for none), input, expected output.
# Escapes in input and expected: \t is a tab, \\ is a backslash; "(empty)" stands for the empty string. Lines starting with # are comments.
# The rules (see scrub_url_credentials): every known value of 4 or more characters, and the part after the first ":" of each (when it is 4
# or more characters), becomes [hidden], longest first; then, in every run of non-space text, everything from the first "://" to the last "@"
# becomes "://[hidden]@" (only when an "@" follows). A run that holds two URLs, or an e-mail address after a URL, is over-masked: that is the
# safe direction and it is part of the contract. Only ASCII spaces and tabs separate runs (a Unicode space inside a run just over-masks).
